label: D2 after a1 led rare to S2, late in the episode (trial >= ~70)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (never at D1 or GO), and only from about episode trial 60 onward. The rate climbs steeply with episode time: 0.1% of steps in trials 60-69, 5.3% in trials 90-99. Almost all activation mass (99%) falls where the shown state is S2 and the last-action input is a1, i.e. a rare a1->S2 transition. Rare a2->S1 and common transitions give only weak activations. Magnitude is largest on a1->S2R steps late in the episode when the previous trial was rewarded. Adding prev_reward==1 raises dev precision to 0.82 (F1 0.73) but lowers mass recall to 0.82. Allowing prev_reward==0 only at ep_trial>=85 gives F1 0.73 with mass recall 0.91. I recorded the simplest predicate (dev F1 0.68, mass recall 0.92). All variables in it are observed at D2, apart from the episode clock, which the agent has to track internally. Value is low (<7.1) whenever the feature is active. Does not fire on rewarded-input steps or on fixation/GO steps.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over this trial (D2: a1 S2) and last trial (D2: a2 S1 r, a1 S1 r, a1 S1 u); timing cues that raise it most: phase=D2 & ep_dec=9, phase=D2 & ep_dec=8, phase=D2 & ep_dec=7.
